# pambrose-gradle-plugins

> Shared Gradle convention plugins for Kotlin JVM projects, distributed via Maven Central.

## Overview

A multi-plugin Gradle convention plugin project built with Kotlin DSL. Each plugin implements
`Plugin<Project>` and lives in `src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/`. Plugins are registered in
`build.gradle.kts` using a `plugin()` helper that derives the plugin ID (`com.pambrose.<id>`)
and implementation class (`com.pambrose.<Name>`) from its arguments.

Group/artifact: `com.pambrose:pambrose-gradle-plugins:1.1.7`

## Plugins

- `com.pambrose.testing`: Configures JUnit Platform with verbose test logging (passed/skipped/failed/standard_error events, full exception format). Adds `ch.qos.logback:logback-classic` to `testRuntimeOnly` by default when the consuming project applies the `java` plugin. Adds `io.kotest:kotest-runner-junit5` and `org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-test` (unversioned) to `testImplementation` by default when the consuming project applies the `org.jetbrains.kotlin.jvm` plugin. Configurable via the `pambroseTesting` extension (`addLogbackClassic`, `logbackVersion`, `addKotest`, `kotestVersion`, `addKotlinTest`).
- `com.pambrose.publishing`: Applies `maven-publish` and `java`, generates a sources JAR, creates a `maven` publication.
- `com.pambrose.envvar`: Loads environment variables from `.env` (configurable) into `JavaExec` and `Test` tasks. Parsed values accessible via `envvar.vars`.
- `com.pambrose.kotlinter`: Applies the kotlinter plugin with `checkstyle` and `plain` reporters.

## Usage

Add Maven Central to `pluginManagement` repositories in `settings.gradle.kts`, then apply plugins in `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
plugins {
  id("com.pambrose.testing") version "1.1.7"
}
```

Also available via Maven Local or version catalog (`libs.versions.toml`).

## Tech Stack

- Gradle 9.8.1, Kotlin DSL
- Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.4.21
- Ben-Manes Versions Plugin 0.65.0 (plugin ID `io.github.ben-manes.versions`)
- Kotlinter 5.7.0
- Kotest 6.2.5 (tests)
- JVM toolchain 17

## Build

- Build: `./gradlew build`
- Test: `./gradlew test`
- Publish locally: `./gradlew publishToMavenLocal`
- Check dependency updates: `./gradlew dependencyUpdates` (also reports the versions `TestingPlugin` injects)
- Audit GitHub Actions workflows: `make zizmor` (requires the `zizmor` CLI)
- Run the GitHub Actions checks locally: `make ci` (zizmor, then a clean `test` and Dokka build)

## CI

GitHub Actions runs on pushes and pull requests to `master`: `tests.yml` runs the test suite, `zizmor.yml`
audits the workflows and Dependabot config (findings go to the Security tab), and `dokka.yml` builds the KDoc
HTML and deploys it to GitHub Pages from `master`. Actions are pinned to commit SHAs. Dependabot proposes
weekly version catalog and GitHub Actions updates after a 7-day cooldown.

## Project Structure

- `src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/` -- Plugin implementations
- `src/test/kotlin/com/pambrose/` -- Integration tests using GradleRunner
- `build.gradle.kts` -- Build config and plugin registration
- `gradle/libs.versions.toml` -- Version catalog
- `.github/workflows/` -- GitHub Actions workflows (tests, zizmor, Dokka)
